name: 16037 · Harmony, PA
findings: ZIP 16037 (Harmony) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16037 (Harmony) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
